blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Headline inflation in Oriental Mindoro accelerated to 9.3 percent in October from 7.7 percent in September, according to official government data released on November 10. The sharp increase brought the province’s average inflation rate from January to October to 6.1 percent, up from 1.8 percent in October last year. Data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) showed the provincial rate surpassed both the national inflation rate of 7.8 percent and the Mimaropa regional average of 6.7 percent for the same month.
